articles.summary: Today, the Foundation for America's Public Lands , the charitable partner of the Bureau of Land Management (BLM), and Polaris , a global leader in powersports, announce the awarding of 10 grants to support off-highway vehicle (OHV) sites on BLM lands in six states. Each project epitomizes the priorities of their ongoing partnership: supporting OHV recreation, promoting safe and responsible off-road riding, enhancing the riding experience in and around high-use recreation areas, and partnering with local communities. Through the partnership, Polaris and the Foundation are investing over $500,000 in grants to support this latest round of OHV projects on BLM public lands. These grants will support projects including safety improvements, wayfinding/new signage, modernization, better trail access, enhanced visitor experience as well as restorations and protections for the natural environment. The BLM manages a number of the country's most iconic and treasured motorized recreation areas.
articles.title: New Investments in OHV Recreation Access and Safety on Bureau of Land Management Lands

articles.summary: Multi-Discipline Champion Joins RZR Factory Racing, Featuring King of the Hammers and Select U.S. Off-Road Races Polaris and RZR Factory Racing today announced a multi-year agreement with championship-winning off-road racer Kyle Chaney, adding one of the sport's most versatile competitors to the team's driver lineup. Chaney will pilot a Polaris RZR Pro R Factory at King of the Hammers and select premier U.S. off-road races. The addition of Chaney further strengthens an already formidable roster, positioning RZR Factory Racing to build on its success and raise the bar even higher. The team has firmly established itself as a dominant force in North American desert racing, capturing three consecutive UTV Open championships in the SCORE World Desert Championship in Baja while claiming victories at the sport's most prestigious events, including the Baja 1000, Baja 500, Baja 400, San Felipe 250, Mint 400, King of the Hammers and Vegas to Reno.
